claims.text: Both stipulated accuracies gave positive probability to exactly 16 correct. For 16 or more, the chances were 62.96% at p=.8 and 23.75% at p=.7. That score did not identify its generator. At p=.8, increasing independent cases from 20 to 80 reduced score SD from 8.94% to 4.47%. Copying records adds no independent cases. For n20,p.8, the inclusive 12–19 sampling band covers 97.8489% of possible scores; it is not an interval for unknown accuracy.
